name: ARCO · Arts + Community
limitations: Official public access guidance and linked route drawings only; no on-site audit. Use the named west or adjacent first-floor north entrances; the historic front entry has steps. The second-floor balcony is not wheelchair accessible despite the general elevator description. No restroom is on the first floor. Current lift operation, outage alternatives, door widths/controls, wheelchair availability and event seating need confirmation. Baby changing stations do not establish adult changing equipment. Undated drawings illustrate suggested routes, not measured clearances or a guaranteed event layout.
facts: ARCO identifies three designated accessible parking spaces beside its main parking-lot entrance. Bay measurements and the complete bay-to-door route are unconfirmed.
When entering the ARCO parking lot, you can find 3 ADA spaces next to the main parking lot entrance.
Wheelchair entry is through the west door or adjacent first-floor north doors only. ARCO explicitly says the second-floor balcony is not wheelchair accessible.
ARCO is accessible for persons using wheelchairs by the west door or adjacent 1st floor north doors only.
The second-floor balcony is not wheelchair accessible.
The venue describes an elevator serving four floors and the lower basement. This does not remove the separate second-floor balcony restriction.
ARCO's elevator runs through all 4 floors of ARCO and the lower level basement.
ARCO says there is no first-floor restroom; other restrooms are reached using the west-wing elevator. Confirm lift operation and the route before attending.
While there is no restroom on the 1st floor of ARCO, you can access all restrooms via the elevator in the west wing of the building.
ARCO describes its restrooms as accessible with one stall each, and baby changing stations in all restrooms. Detailed fittings and adult changing equipment are unconfirmed.
Restrooms at ARCO are ADA accessible with one stall per restroom.
All restrooms have baby changing stations.
The venue says wayfinding signs throughout the building include Spanish and Braille. It does not document hearing assistance or tactile coverage beyond these signs.
Wayfinding signs can be found throughout ARCO. These signs have also been translated into Spanish and Braille.
ARCO lists a wheelchair available on site. Availability, dimensions and any staff assistance need confirming.
ARCO has a wheelchair available on site.
ARCO encourages renters to designate a gender-neutral restroom and offers signs for that purpose. The arrangement depends on the event.
we encourage renters to choose a restroom to designate as gender-neutral, at which time ARCO can provide you with the appropriate signs.
The access page welcomes trained service animals. Ask the venue about any event-specific arrival arrangements.
ARCO welcomes all those with trained service animals to use our facility.
